items.heading: Choosing to Step Into
items.text: Choosing to step into the unit exactly as it runs today, choosing to modernise it with newer automation and export capability, or choosing an independent engineering career instead are three genuinely different decisions with real income and relationship consequences - not one obvious answer.

items.heading: Getting This Right, Instead
items.text: Getting this right, instead of drifting into the family unit out of habit or walking away without a plan, is what actually moves you toward earlier financial freedom.
